description: An exam.now past paper as structured JSON (metadata, questions, parts, prompts, marks, answer kinds, figure URLs), a few questions at a time. Each part's answer.onSite is true when it needs a graph or drawing and can only be answered on exam.now; the other parts can be typed in chat for mark_answer. Use next_from to get the next page. include_mark_scheme adds the mark-scheme rows for the same questions and needs a linked exam.now account (a free one is fine).

from_question.description: First question to return (1-based position in the paper).

paper_id.description: exam.now paper id from find_past_paper, e.g. 0580_s24_42 (syllabus code, series letter s/w/m and two-digit year, component).

name: get_paper
title: Get a whole paper
